title: OpenAI implements Pando source control system for monorepo
excerpt: The new Git backend reduces median push latency by nearly 5x for the company's monorepo.
bodyHtml:
OpenAI announced on November 2, 2026, the implementation of Pando, a new backend for Git repositories designed to manage the company's monorepo. The system was developed to support the increased volume of concurrent work generated by the use of Codex.

Pando is designed to provide horizontally scalable writes and maximize read throughput while maintaining compatibility with the Git protocol. This allows engineers and agents to adopt the system into existing workflows without changing how the team uses Git.

According to OpenAI, the system now delivers nearly a petabyte of Git data per day and has reduced median push latency by nearly 5x in production. The company stated that it intends to continue contributing improvements from its copy of Git to the upstream community to support agent-scale work.
